summary: Loads the web-tree-sitter runtime and every grammar registered via makeParser (ensureParsersReady, serialised and idempotent), and hands each extractor a getParser() over a wrapper that accepts string or chunk-callback input and deletes the previous tree on each parse. resetParsers() synchronously builds a fresh Parser per loaded grammar (it keeps entry.lang and a runtimeSync handle for this) without deleting the old ones; it exists because a parser stopped mid-parse by parse-guard keeps throwing RuntimeError: Aborted() on every later parse.
